title: space facts that BREAK your brain 🌌 | part 3
description: Space does not care about your logic. Part 4 tomorrow.
hook: Space does not care about your logic.
facts: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
One teaspoon of a neutron star weighs about as much as a mountain.
Astronauts say space smells like burnt steak.
The Sun is ninety nine percent of all the mass in the solar system.
On Neptune, scientists think it rains diamonds.
outro: Follow for part four. Space gets stranger.
